title: Qualify review-phase gate stage 4 for a phase whose only surface is a throwaway mockup
reason: Stage 3 gained a mockup qualifier in v34; stage 4 did not. A design-only phase can no longer be waived, so its review would append a headline check for a route the apply phase later deletes, leaving a dead line on the cumulative Regression Checklist every later review re-runs.
trigger: Before the first design-only or mockup-shipping phase reaches its review.
